items.statement: The submission uses the two named periodic cells and neutral singlet HMF with explicit identity and documents candidate generation, deduplication, relaxation and convergence.
items.expected: System IDs and input provenance are explicit; candidate and validation records are present.

items.statement: The interface charge-transfer analysis defines a reproducible partition and sign convention and reports sensitivity or limitations.
items.expected: Charge partition, sign and uncertainty/limitation are stated and tied to the CoO and NiO domains.

items.statement: The computed adsorption energies distinguish the supplied NiO and CoO–NiO(1:3) systems.
items.expected: A system-identified comparison of E_ads values is reported, with formula and units.

items.statement: The heterostructure exhibits net interfacial electron redistribution consistent with the paper’s reported charge analysis.
items.expected: The submitted sign-defined charge-transfer result supports electron redistribution between CoO and NiO, or a scientifically justified bounded-failure limitation.
